g3-score.title: Score recall / noise; prove the instrument can miss and can raise+reject noise
g3-score.imperative: FIRST verify GROUND_TRUTH.json's hash matches the one recorded as evidence at g1-seed (fail loudly and stop if it does not — this is the mechanical half of 'frozen before dispatch', not merely a prose promise). Score every reported finding against GROUND_TRUTH.json. Compute recall = |SD1-SD4 correctly reported| / 4. Record SD5's outcome EXPLICITLY as one of {FOUND, NOT-FOUND} — never omit it or treat silence about it as NOT-FOUND by default; a non-reading (a viewpoint that never addressed SD5 at all) must be recorded distinctly from a reading of NOT-FOUND (a viewpoint that considered it and rejected it) — quote the specific viewpoint text (or its absence) that supports the recorded outcome. Record DECOY1's outcome the same way: {FLAGGED-AS-DEFECT, NOT-FLAGGED}; if NOT-FLAGGED by any viewpoint, that is itself the honest result for the noise-probe (report it as a null on this specific probe, never re-seed a louder decoy to force a hit — scoped nulls doctrine). Compute noise ratio = |reported findings not in {SD1..SD4}| / |all reported findings|. Attest c1 only once SD5 and DECOY1 both carry an explicit, quoted, non-defaulted outcome.

postconditions.statement: SD5 (miss control) and DECOY1 (noise control) each carry an explicit, quote-grounded outcome (not a default/silence-as-answer) recorded BEFORE recall/noise numbers are treated as final; GROUND_TRUTH.json hash reverified unchanged since g1-seed
